verdict.rationale: Inngest's core value proposition is durable execution: steps are memoized/checkpointed so a run resumes from the last completed step rather than restarting, explicitly documented for crashes ('If the process dies at step 7 of 12, the agent picks up at step 7 — not step 1') and reinforced by retry policies and durable endpoints docs; community reviews independently corroborate reliability in production use. Missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark/incident report specifically demonstrating recovery after an infra outage or deploy, only vendor docs plus general reliability testimonials.
